commentary.speaker: play_by_play
commentary.text: Seed 20261178 is underway. At every intersection, the walker will make a fair and completely uninformed decision.

commentary.speaker: stats_desk
commentary.text: The revisit desk is open: 32.7% of segment choices so far have returned to previously covered ground.

commentary.speaker: color
commentary.text: No destination has been selected because destinations are a form of planning, and planning has been disallowed.

commentary.speaker: field_reporter
commentary.text: Race control reports 94 distinct segments acquired. The walker remembers none of them.

commentary.speaker: play_by_play
commentary.text: This is not a route through San Francisco, Córdoba so much as an argument with adjacency.

commentary.speaker: stats_desk
commentary.text: Halfway through the excerpt. The full median problem remains approximately twelve thousand miles long.

commentary.speaker: color
commentary.text: Revisit rate: 56.7%. Progress is occurring, but largely in an emotional sense.

commentary.speaker: field_reporter
commentary.text: HPI remains zero. Every bridge-tagged way was removed before the walker could develop maritime ambitions.

commentary.speaker: play_by_play
commentary.text: OH MY GOODNESS, THE WALKER IS ALMOST AT THE MARATHON MARK—AND STILL HAS NO IDEA WHERE HE IS GOING!!!!!

commentary.speaker: stats_desk
commentary.text: The first random marathon is complete. The representative full seed has roughly 19,314 kilometers left to wander.
